document_purpose: To collect information required to evaluate a tenant and establish a rental relationship between the tenant and property owner.

fields.reason: Required to identify the legal tenant and execute an enforceable residential lease contract.
Essential for property management communication, maintenance requests, and emergency notifications.
Required for electronic lease execution, rent payment portal access, and digital delivery of legal notices.
Often requested for credit and criminal background checks, but can be replaced by direct third-party screening services to reduce exposure.
Marital status is irrelevant to rental qualification and introduces unlawful discrimination risks under fair housing standards.
Religious beliefs are completely irrelevant to rental qualifications and collecting them violates the Fair Housing Act.
Required to verify current tenancy, assess residency stability, and contact previous landlords for reference checks.
Directly indicates financial stability and ongoing ability to meet recurring monthly rent obligations.
Useful for independent employment verification, though verifiable pay stubs or bank statements can serve as alternative proof.
Essential for determining rent-to-income ratio (standard industry threshold of monthly income >= 2.5x to 3x rent).
Full banking account numbers are unnecessary during rental application screening and expose the applicant to financial fraud risks.
